ProjectSettings.ProjectName: Typically the file name without an extension of the installer. DEFAULT: File name (without extension) of installer specified in InstallerPath
ProjectSettings.ProjectDescription: A brief one line description. DEFAULT: <ProjectName>
ProjectSettings.IconFile: Path to the icon file. DEFAULT: Source file of the command line executable
ProjectSettings.WorkingFolder: Path to the folder to use when the packaged application is launched. DEFAULT: Folder of the command line executable, if any
ProjectSettings.CommandLine: REQUIRED: Command line to use when the packaged application is launched, including parameters

PreCaptureCommands: Commands placed here will execute before capture process begins
Each array entry is a new line in a BAT file

CaptureSettings.CaptureTimeoutSec: INTEGER: Time in seconds before quitting the capture process. DEFAULT: 0
CaptureSettings.CaptureAllProcesses: BOOLEAN: if false, Studio will only capture installer and child processes. DEFAULT: false
CaptureSettings.IncludeSystemInstallationProcesses: BOOLEAN: if false, Studio will not capture system installation processes. DEFAULT: true
CaptureSettings.IgnoreChangesUnderInstallerPath: BOOLEAN: if false, file changes that occur in the same path as the installer will be ignored. DEFAULT: true
CaptureSettings.ReplaceRegistryShortPaths: BOOLEAN: if true, shortcut paths in registry are replaced with full path names. DEFAULT: true
RegistryExclusions: A list of registry paths to exclude from capture
FileExclusions: A list of file paths to exclude from capture
ProcessExclusions: A list of process paths to exclude from capture

ProcessInclusions.IncludeChildProcesses: BOOLEAN: If true, processes included in capture will also have their child processes captured
Include: An array of process names to include in capture

HkcuRegistrySync.Enabled: BOOLEAN (added in JSON 1.5): If true, wraps the install with a before/after snapshot of TargetSid's HKEY_USERS hive and replicates only what changed into this session's own live HKEY_CURRENT_USER, so Studio's capture picks it up. Use this when packaging remotely (e.g. over WinRM) with no user interactively logged on, where an installer's HKCU writes otherwise land under HKEY_USERS\<SID> and are never captured, since there is no interactive session for HKCU to map to. Requires CaptureCommands.Enabled to also be true. DEFAULT: false
HkcuRegistrySync.TargetSid: REQUIRED when Enabled: SID of the user whose HKEY_USERS hive should be watched, e.g. S-1-5-21-1111111111-2222222222-3333333333-1001. If that SID's hive is not already loaded, it is loaded on demand from its NTUSER.DAT (via ProfileList) and unloaded again afterward.
SubKeys: Which subkey(s) under the hive to watch. DEFAULT: ["Software"], which covers most per-user application settings

CaptureCommands.Enabled: BOOLEAN: If true, a BAT file will be produced with installation commands
CaptureCommands.InstallerPrefix: A: Occurs before installer path in execution command (A + B + C) EX: msiexec /i
CaptureCommands.InstallerPath: REQUIRED: B: Path to the installer, second in execution command (A + B + C) EX: path\to\msi
CaptureCommands.InstallerCommands: C: Occurs after installer in execution command (A + B + C) EX: AllUsers=1 TARGETDIR="%programfiles%\Python2" /qn /norestart

PostInstallActions.Enabled: BOOLEAN: If true, commands placed here will be executed after installer commands
Commands: An array of commands to be placed in a BAT file, will be included in capture

ExampleName.SourcePath: REQUIRED: Path to the source folder
ExampleName.DestinationPath: Path to the destination folder. When it is empty, it is assumed to be the same as the SourcePath
ExampleName.IncludeSubfolders: BOOLEAN: Recursively include subfolders. DEFAULT: false
ExampleName.IncludeFilesInFolders: BOOLEAN: Include files within the folder(s). DEFAULT: false

ExampleName.SourceKey: REQUIRED: Path to source registry location
ExampleName.DestinationKey: Path to destination registry location. When it is empty, it is assumed to be the same as the SourceKey
ExampleName.IncludeSubkeys: BOOLEAN: Recursively include subkeys. DEFAULT: false
ExampleName.IncludeValuesInKeys: BOOLEAN: Include values within the key(s). DEFAULT: false

ExampleName.Path: REQUIRED: Path to the root folder
ExampleName.Merged: BOOLEAN: Set root forder to merged state. DEFAULT: true

ExampleName.Name: Name of file including extension
ExampleName.Destination: Location of where file will be placed, placing the file is included in capture
Content: An array of content to place in the file
Each entry is a new line

ExampleAddOrSetValue.Action: Add (OPTIONAL, DEFAULT): Sets/creates the values listed in Keys under Location
Keys: An array of updates to given registry locations, format is Name=type:data

ExampleDeleteValue.Action: DeleteValue: removes only the named values in Keys, the key itself is left in place
Keys: An array of value NAMES (no type/data) to delete under Location
@ (use this to delete the key's unnamed/default value)

ExampleDeleteKey.Location: Path to registry location that will be deleted entirely, including all subkeys and values
ExampleDeleteKey.Action: DeleteKey: Keys is ignored/not required for this action

VirtualizationSettings.DefaultDispositionLayer: INTEGER: Default disposition layer (3 or 4) for newly captured assets. DEFAULT: 3
VirtualizationSettings.DefaultServiceVirtualizationAction: Action to take for newly captured services and drivers. Possible values: None, Register, Start. DEFAULT: Register

ExampleName.Path: Path to files/folder which will have its disposition layer modified
ExampleName.Layer: INTEGER: disposition layer for this path
ExampleName.Recurse: BOOLEAN: Include subfolders/files starting from Path

ExampleName.Layer: INTEGER: disposition layer for registry location
ExampleName.Recurse: BOOLEAN: Include nested registry locations beyond this Location

SandboxFileExclusions: Array of file paths to excluded from sandbox
SandboxRegistryExclusions: Array of registry paths to be excluded from sandbox

AllowAccessLayer4.AllowReadAndCopy: BOOLEAN: If this is true, processes in array will be able to read and copy layer 4 assets
Processes: Array of process names that are allowed to detect files in the virtualized appset at layer 4

DenyAccessLayer3: Array of processes that will be prevented from detecting layer 3 and 4 assets

OutputSettings.EncryptionMethod: Type of encryption method to use. Possible Values: None, AES-256-Enhanced. DEFAULT: AES-256-Enhanced
OutputSettings.CompressionMethod: Type of compression method to use. Possible Values: None, LZMA, LZ4. DEFAULT: LZMA
OutputSettings.OutputFileNameNoExt: Optional custom name of output file not including extensions
OutputSettings.FinalizeIntoSTP: BOOLEAN: If true, files are condensed into an stp file, else they are left as standalone files. DEFAULT: true
OutputSettings.OutputFolder: Path to the folder where Studio output will be placed. DEFAULT: Current folder
